title: capsicum frutescens var. microcarpum
intro: Capsicum frutescens var. microcarpum, commonly known as Malabar pepper or bird's eye chili, is a variety of chili pepper that belongs to the Capsicum family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and aiding in digestion, due to its potential to inhibit the production of prostaglandins and other inflammatory mediators. The therapeutic actions of Capsicum frutescens var. microcarpum include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which may help in treating conditions such as arthritis, wounds, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include capsaicin, flavonoids, and carotenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
